page_title: CAG 4-0 VER | Cagliari v Verona 31/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' Kevin Bonacina is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+1' 4 - 0 It's a goal! Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Gabriele Zappa and scores magnificently from close range into the left side of the goal. 4:0.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
88' The Cagliari players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
87' Fabio Pisacane has decided to make a change. Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) replaces Marco Palestra.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) comes onto the pitch for Sebastiano Esposito.
84' 3 - 0 Goal! Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:0.
84' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
82' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Sandi Lovric will be replaced by Cheikh Niasse (Verona).
79' Substitution. Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) has come on for Adam Obert.
76' Elia Caprile is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Daniel Mosquera (Verona). Easy save!
73' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
70' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) takes it short.
68' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
66' Fabio Pisacane has decided to substitute Semih Kilicsoy and he is replaced by Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luca Mazzitelli leaves the pitch and Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) comes on.
62' Cagliari control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
59' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
58' We are about to witness a subsitution. Al Musrati (Verona) for Antoine Bernede.
58' The referee signals a substitution. Suat Serdar (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Abdou Harroui.
58' Paolo Zanetti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Daniel Mosquera (Verona) replacing Pol Lirola.
57' Verona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
54' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
51' Amin Sarr (Verona) must have known he would be sent off for this foul, but he had to stop the opponent at all costs. Kevin Bonacina shows him a second yellow card and the game has ended for him.
49' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
48' Pol Lirola (Verona) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Referee Kevin Bonacina points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) goes wild in celebration.
45+3' Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) puts the ball into the back of the net, but referee Kevin Bonacina immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.

45+2' 2 - 0 Sebastiano Esposito sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 2:0.
45+2' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Great teamplay by Cagliari as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
41' Gift Orban (Verona) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
38' Sandi Lovric (Verona) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
36' 1 - 0 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom left corner. Good team effort!
34' Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
34' Sandi Lovric (Verona) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.

32' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Michel Adopo (Cagliari) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Simone Perilli pulls off a brilliant save.
31' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
29' The substitution has been made. Sandi Lovric (Verona) has replaced Roberto Gagliardini.
28' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

27' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
23' Amin Sarr (Verona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
20' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

19' Antoine Bernede (Verona) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Kevin Bonacina blows for a foul. Free kick. Cagliari will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
18' The game is interrupted as Gift Orban (Verona) is flagged offside.
17' Pol Lirola (Verona) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
12' Verona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
9' The Cagliari players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
6' Today's referee Kevin Bonacina rightly decides to book Amin Sarr (Verona) for his harsh tackle.
5' Kevin Bonacina couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Adam Obert (Cagliari) and blew his whistle. It's a free kick to Verona in a dangerous position.
4' A clumsy foul by Antoine Bernede (Verona) and Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle. A free kick to Cagliari.
3' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
2' The game is interrupted now, Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Verona will kick the game off.
Kevin Bonacina was nominated as the referee for this game.
